messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The process is triggered by the demand of a functional department to fill a post. The post is advertised, applicants apply, the applications are checked and the post is filled. The process finishes when the post was filled, precisely through the conclusion of a contract of employment.

      <outgoing>flow2</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <intermediateCatchEvent id="catch_application" name="Application received">

      <incoming>flow_retry</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow3</outgoing>
      <messageEventDefinition id="messageEventDef1"/>

      <outgoing>flow4</outgoing>

      <outgoing>flow_suitable</outgoing>
      <outgoing>flow_retry</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <userTask id="task_conclude_contract" name="Conclude contract of employment">
      <incoming>flow_suitable</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow5</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <endEvent id="end_post_filled" name="Post filled">

    <sequenceFlow id="flow_suitable" name="Yes" sourceRef="gateway_qualifications" targetRef="task_conclude_contract"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_retry" name="No / Wait for more applications" sourceRef="gateway_qualifications" targetRef="catch_application"/>
